Try mode: press anything, including Done. Done only shows what it would save; your HUD settings stay as they are.

Set up your status HUD

The HUD is the panel above your main session's prompt. It shows every Claude session you run and how hard your machine is working. Each numbered item below can be kept or removed. This picture uses sample data, and some items only appear when they matter.

What should each session's dot show?
The coloured dot at the start of every session row.
Which picture at the top of the pane?
Only the pane layout (/hud pane) shows it; the band in the picture below has no room for one.

Point at a number to see what it is; click it to jump to it in the list below, where you keep or remove it. A grey, crossed-out number is an item removed in your current settings: press Keep in the list to bring it back. Scroll sideways if the picture is wider than your window.

Every item, and when it appears: Shown by default Appears by itself when it applies Appears once you turn something on
When you are done
  1. Press Done at the bottom of the page. Your choices are saved straight away.
  2. The HUD redraws with them from each session's next start. Ask Claude to open this page again any time.
  1. Press Copy my choices at the bottom of the page.
  2. Paste it into your Claude chat and send it.
  3. Claude applies it, and the HUD redraws from its next start. You can come back to this page any time.
